final: WITH driver_totals AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total FROM results GROUP BY driverId), overall_totals AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS overall_total FROM driver_totals), average_totals AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM driver_totals), paired AS (SELECT d.driverId, d.total, o.overall_total, a.average_total FROM driver_totals d JOIN overall_totals o ON o.overall_total IS NOT NULL JOIN average_totals a ON a.average_total IS NOT NULL WHERE d.total > a.average_total) SELECT AVG(total) AS average_kept_driver_total, AVG(total * 1.0 / overall_total) AS average_kept_ratio, AVG(total - average_total) AS average_excess FROM paired
